summary: Implemented prepareUpdate following the prepareQuery pattern, without running anything or committing. Changes: (1) rdflib/plugins/sparql/sparql.py adds an Update class (prologue, algebra). (2) rdflib/plugins/sparql/processor.py adds prepareUpdate(updateString, initNs={}, base=None), which wraps translateUpdate output in Update and sets _original_args; SPARQLUpdateProcessor.update accepts prepared Updates via evalUpdate. (3) rdflib/plugins/sparql/update.py: evalUpdate unwraps Update to its operation list; plain lists still work. (4) rdflib/plugins/sparql/__init__.py exports prepareUpdate. (5) New test/test_sparql_prepare_update.py with tests for return type, repeated application, equivalence with string updates, and initNs handling. Judgement calls: translateUpdate still returns a list, wrapped by Update; Update.prologue is taken from the last operation's prologue; no docs were added. Nothing was executed, so the new tests and existing suite are unverified.
